name: Lone Star Lakes Park
method: DWR quota (lottery) hunts with the City of Suffolk; closed to other hunting
dates: Hunt #212 (October periods) and #213 (November periods); specific days assigned with the drawing; applications closed 2026-08-28. Standby drawing, walk-in only, on the Friday before each hunt.
notes: City of Suffolk park. Weapon: shotgun, muzzleloader or archery (hunter's choice). 8 hunters per period, each may bring 1 guest. $7.50 application, plus $25 per person paid to the City of Suffolk on hunt day. Mandatory 5 a.m. briefing on the first day. The polygon (DWR, 1,101 ac) includes the park's lakes.

name: Dutch Gap Conservation Area (waterfowl blind sites)
method: DWR quota (lottery) hunt; floating blinds at designated blind stakes only
dates: Hunt #103: Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays in the last two segments of the general duck season, plus the last day of the season; applications closed 2026-09-25.
notes: 3 hunters per date set, each may bring 2 guests; bring your own decoys and floating blind. 4VAC15-260-170 prohibits waterfowl hunting in the Dutch Gap Cutoff without a DWR permit. Owner is not named on DWR's page; Dutch Gap Conservation Area is a Chesterfield County park (from general knowledge, not checked against a county source). The polygon (DWR, 457 ac) is mostly water.

name: City of Franklin urban archery area (city property)
method: archery only by city permit (book up to 5 dates online; staff review each application; 2 hunters per calendar day)
dates: Urban archery Sept 5-Oct 2, 2026 and Jan 3-Mar 28, 2027 (antlerless only); early archery Oct 3-Nov 13, 2026; Nov 14, 2026-Jan 2, 2027 (city-limits season).
notes: Elevated stand at least 10 ft with full-body harness; no dogs; no field dressing on city land. Virginia driver's license and hunting license required. The polygon is a hand-drawn sketch in the city's public web map, not a parcel layer (low positional confidence, 90 ac). Not checked by me directly; from the research sub-agent.

name: Fairfax County Deer Management Archery Program (NOT MAPPED)
method: approved archers only: apply individually, pass an archery qualification, IBEP course and background check; police staff select and assign archers to groups
dates: Sept 12, 2026-Feb 13, 2027; no hunting in county parks on Sundays; archery ends Jan 9, 2027 at Lake Fairfax, Huntley Meadows and Dogue Creek. Applications ran June 1-28, 2026.
notes: Not public hunting in the usual sense, so not mapped. GIS exists if wanted: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/gispub2/rest/services/FCPA/DeerManagement/FeatureServer/1 with MANAGEMENT_METHOD IN ('Archery','Archery/Sharpshooting','Archery/Managed Hunt') (sub-agent tested: about 147 features). Useful as 'closed except program archers'.

name: Banshee Reeks Nature Preserve, Loudoun County (NOT MAPPED)
method: county lottery deer hunt and novice workshop (registration via loudoun.gov/webtrac), per DWR's managed-hunts page
dates: No 2026-27 dates found; DWR's workshop text still shows 2023 dates and Loudoun's preserve page does not mention hunting.
notes: Confirm with Loudoun PRCS (703-777-0343) before mapping.
